stories.title: Police appeal after suspicious incident at Chester Retail Park McDonald’s
stories.summary: Police have released CCTV images of a man they want to speak to after reports he entered the women’s toilets at a McDonald’s in Chester and began acting suspiciously. stories.title: Betsi review offers first clear path to improvement, says minister
stories.summary: Health Minister Mabon ap Gwynfor plans to appoint three new board members to deliver the review's 21 recommendations, with actions due within six months.

stories.title: Flintshire would see second-biggest council tax fall in Wales if reform went ahead, IFS says
stories.summary: Institute for Fiscal Studies figures show Flintshire bills would drop 5.9% under 2028 reforms the Welsh Government now wants to postpone to 2032.

stories.title: Campaign launched for later Wrexham to Bidston trains after evening games
stories.summary: Football fans using the Borderlands line to reach evening games at Wrexham’s Racecourse often have to choose between the final whistle and the last train home, two Senedd Members have said.
